title: EvidenceBundle
description: Standardized interoperability contract unifying deterministic Forensic ML features, Gemini multimodal reasoning, and calibrated decision fusion across images, videos, and audio.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the EvidenceBundle schema specification.

bundle_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence bundle instance (e.g. UUIDv4 or prefixed identifier).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of bundle creation.

media.description: Physical and contextual attributes of the media inspected directly from the browser viewport.

media_id.description: Deterministic identifier assigned to the DOM media element by FORENSIGHT.

mime_type.description: Observed or declared MIME type (e.g., image/jpeg, video/mp4, audio/mpeg).

width.description: Native horizontal resolution in pixels, if applicable.

height.description: Native vertical resolution in pixels, if applicable.

duration_ms.description: Media duration in milliseconds, if applicable for temporal media.

source.description: Absolute source URL, origin domain, or data URI of the media item.

access_status.description: Access state determined during browser media acquisition.

forensic_ml.description: Empirical signal processing metrics and probabilistic model inferences from the FORENSIGHT Forensic ML pipeline.

available.description: Indicates whether the forensic ML processing engine was executed successfully.

model.description: Identifier and version of the forensic machine learning model or analytical suite applied.

probabilities.description: Class probability distribution estimated by the forensic classification layer.

real.description: Calibrated probability of authentic/unmanipulated camera capture.

manipulated.description: Calibrated probability of localized splicing, inpainting, or post-capture tampering.

ai_generated.description: Calibrated probability of full synthetic generation (diffusion, GAN, speech synthesis).

forensic_features.description: Structured empirical physical and mathematical measurements extracted directly from pixel, spectral, or waveform data. Attributes are optional to accommodate varying media modalities and acquisition conditions.

jpeg.description: Quantization table consistency, DCT coefficient distributions, and double-compression artifacts.

noise.description: Photo-Response Non-Uniformity (PRNU) and high-frequency residual noise statistics.

frequency.description: 2D Fourier / Discrete Cosine spectral energy distributions.

edges.description: Sobel/Canny edge gradient coherence, boundary discontinuities, and seam carving indicators.

texture.description: Spatial entropy, Gray-Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM), and structural smoothness.

compression.description: Codec-level container parameters and GOP/macroblock metrics.

metadata.description: File header structure, EXIF tags, C2PA content credentials, or software provenance.

gemini.description: High-level multimodal semantic reasoning, contextual plausibility, and anomaly interpretation produced by Google Gemini.

available.description: Indicates whether Gemini multimodal inspection was successfully invoked.

model.description: Specific Gemini model identifier deployed (e.g. gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-2.0-flash).

assessment.description: High-level contextual assessment generated by Gemini multimodal reasoning.

observations.description: Objective semantic, lighting, physical, or contextual observations noted during inspection.

indicators.description: Specific physical inconsistencies, anatomical anomalies, or synthesis signatures identified.

limitations.description: Observational constraints reported by Gemini (e.g., low resolution, occlusion, lack of contextual provenance).

fusion.description: Deterministic multi-signal synthesis resolving agreement or tension between Forensic ML measurements and Gemini semantic reasoning.

agreement.description: True if Forensic ML classification and Gemini multimodal assessment point to concordant conclusions.

conflict.description: True if Forensic ML signals contradict Gemini semantic observations (e.g. clean pixels but impossible physical lighting, or heavy compression noise mistaken for generation).

final_verdict.description: Consolidated forensic verdict reaching evidentiary threshold.

status.description: Evidentiary state of the consolidated analysis.

reasons.description: Explicit, verifiable rationales justifying the final verdict and explaining any resolved tensions.

limitations.description: Global operational or methodological limitations of this bundle (e.g., aggressive social platform re-encoding, low frame count, partial capture).
